description_en: Queries the configuration parameters and running parameters of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的配置参数和运行参数
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-parameters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --node-id r-bp1xxxxxxxxxxxxx-db-0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeParameters

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html to query available regions. Use this parameter to specify the region of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.
> Specify this parameter to query the parameter settings of a specific node in a cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

parameters.name: node_id
